name: Rigid Parametric Alignment
definition: A differentiable solver that estimates a 3D rigid transformation T ∈ SE(3) from correspondences by minimizing the reprojection error in a closed form using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
summary: Rigid Parametric Alignment is a differentiable solver that computes a closed-form 3D rigid transformation from point correspondences using SVD, distinguishing itself by providing an analytical solution without iterative optimization.
